chain_8_9_10sp.label: Chain (8/9/10-speed)
chain_8_9_10sp.notes: Replace at 0.75% wear via Park CC-4.2 gauge. Check monthly or every 500mi. Running past limit wears cassette and chainrings prematurely.

chain_11sp.label: Chain (11-speed)
chain_11sp.notes: Replace at 0.5% wear via Park CC-4.2 gauge. 11sp requires tighter tolerance than 10sp and below.

chain_12sp.label: Chain (12-speed)
chain_12sp.notes: Replace at 0.5% wear via Park CC-4.2 gauge.

cassette_8_9_10sp.label: Cassette (8/9/10-speed)
cassette_8_9_10sp.notes: Rule of thumb: every 3 chains, ~3000–5000mi. Inspect tooth profile for hooking/sharkfin shape.

cassette_11sp.label: Cassette (11-speed)
cassette_11sp.notes: Replace every 3 chains or when teeth start hooking.

cassette_12sp.label: Cassette (12-speed)
cassette_12sp.notes: Replace every 3 chains or when teeth start hooking.

chainring.label: Chainring
chainring.notes: Rough avg 6000–12000mi. Aluminum wears faster than steel. Inspect for hooked/pointed teeth at each cassette change.

derailleur_pulleys.label: Derailleur pulleys (jockey wheels)
derailleur_pulleys.notes: Replace when teeth are visibly sharp or when the derailleur feels gritty. Avg 10000–15000mi.

front_derailleur.label: Front derailleur
front_derailleur.notes: Lifetime component unless damaged. Inspect pivots, cable anchor, and cage for wear twice a year. Service (clean and lube pivots) when shifting feels imprecise.

rear_derailleur.label: Rear derailleur
rear_derailleur.notes: Lifetime component unless damaged. Check pivots, cable anchor, and B-tension screw. Replace pulleys separately as a wear item.

crankset.label: Crankset
crankset.notes: Lifetime component. Chainrings wear separately. Check crank arm bolt torque every few months.

shifter.label: Shifter
shifter.notes: Lifetime component. Internal cable stubs can fray — replace shift cables first before suspecting the shifter.

disc_pads_hydraulic.label: Disc brake pads (hydraulic)
disc_pads_hydraulic.notes: Replace when friction material ≤1mm (Shimano minimum 0.5mm, SRAM measures 3mm total including steel backing). Fresh pads are ~2mm material. Inspect by eye monthly.

disc_pads_mechanical.label: Disc brake pads (mechanical)
disc_pads_mechanical.notes: Mechanical discs often wear slightly faster due to uneven piston travel. Same 1mm minimum rule.

rim_brake_pads.label: Rim brake pads
rim_brake_pads.notes: Replace when wear grooves are gone or pad is glazed. Rim brake pads eat rims in the wet — check rims alongside pads.

brake_rotor.label: Disc brake rotor
brake_rotor.notes: Replace at manufacturer minimum thickness stamped on rotor (Shimano 1.5mm, SRAM 1.55mm). Fresh rotors are 1.8mm. Inspect every 6 months.

mineral_oil_shimano.label: Hydraulic brake fluid (Shimano mineral oil)
mineral_oil_shimano.notes: Bleed every 12–24 months. Heavy descenders: 6–12 months. Symptoms of old fluid: spongy lever, reduced power. Mineral oil doesn't absorb moisture like DOT, so intervals are longer.

dot_fluid_sram.label: Hydraulic brake fluid (SRAM DOT 5.1)
dot_fluid_sram.notes: Bleed every 12 months. DOT absorbs moisture over time and boiling point drops. Never mix DOT with mineral oil — destroys seals.

brake_caliper_hydraulic.label: Brake caliper (hydraulic)
brake_caliper_hydraulic.notes: Lifetime component unless pistons seize. Clean pistons and reseat twice a year. Piston seals can wear but are rarely user-serviceable.

brake_caliper_mechanical.label: Brake caliper (mechanical)
brake_caliper_mechanical.notes: Lifetime component. Pivots and cable anchor wear — lube pivots when braking feels sluggish.

shift_cable.label: Shift cable (inner)
shift_cable.notes: Replace annually (6 months heavy use). Fraying at the shifter head is the main failure mode — inspect where cable exits shifter. A frayed cable can snap mid-shift.

brake_cable_mechanical.label: Brake cable (mechanical inner)
brake_cable_mechanical.notes: Replace annually. Thicker than shift cable but same wet-weather vulnerability.

cable_housing.label: Cable housing
cable_housing.notes: Replace every second cable change, or when housing ends are crushed/split. Grit contamination degrades shifting more than most users realize.

tire_road.label: Tire (road / smooth)
tire_road.notes: Replace at tread wear indicators, visible casing threads, or repeated flats. Rough avg 2000–4000mi (3000 default).

tire_gravel.label: Tire (gravel)
tire_gravel.notes: Gravel tires wear faster than road due to side-knob abuse. 2000–4000mi in mixed conditions; less on chunky singletrack.

tire_mtb.label: Tire (MTB)
tire_mtb.notes: 1500–3000mi typical. Varies wildly with terrain — chunky rocks eat tires fast.

tubeless_sealant_standard.label: Tubeless sealant (Stan's / standard)
tubeless_sealant_standard.notes: Refresh every 2–3 months. Hot/dry climates dry faster. Check monthly by removing valve core and inserting a thin stick — dry residue means refresh.

tubeless_sealant_endurance.label: Tubeless sealant (Orange Seal Endurance)
tubeless_sealant_endurance.notes: Longer-lasting formula, 4–6 months between refills. Still climate-dependent.

rim_tape_tubeless.label: Rim tape (tubeless)
rim_tape_tubeless.notes: Inspect annually when refreshing sealant. Failed tape causes mysterious slow leaks that people blame on sealant.

rim.label: Rim
rim.notes: Lifetime component (disc brake). Rim brake rims wear through the braking surface — inspect for concavity on rim brake bikes.

spokes.label: Spokes / wheel build
spokes.notes: True and tension every 6 months. Individual spoke failures are rare on quality builds but worth catching early.

wheel_hub_sealed.label: Wheel hub (sealed cartridge)
wheel_hub_sealed.notes: Sealed cartridge bearings: 5000–10000mi. Replace when bearings are rough or develop play. Don't repack cartridge bearings — replace them.

wheel_hub_cup_cone.label: Wheel hub (cup-and-cone, Shimano)
wheel_hub_cup_cone.notes: Regrease and adjust annually. Balls and cones replaceable individually. Outlasts sealed cartridge if maintained.

bottom_bracket_sealed.label: Bottom bracket (sealed cartridge)
bottom_bracket_sealed.notes: 10000–15000mi for quality BSA threaded BBs. Press-fit BBs often wear faster. Replace when rough, creaky, or develops play.

headset_sealed.label: Headset (sealed)
headset_sealed.notes: 3–5 years typical. Replace when indexed or rough. Annual clean and regrease extends life.

pedal_bearings.label: Pedal bearings
pedal_bearings.notes: Grease every 12–24 months. Clipless pedals often have user-serviceable seals. Replace when axle develops play.

bar_tape.label: Bar tape
bar_tape.notes: Replace annually, or 6 months for heavy sweat / indoor trainer use. Sweat salt corrodes bars over time.

grips_mtb.label: Grips (flat bar)
grips_mtb.notes: Replace when worn through, slipping, or hardened.

saddle.label: Saddle
saddle.notes: Lifetime unless the rails or shell crack. Inspect rails near the clamp monthly.

seatpost.label: Seatpost
seatpost.notes: Remove and regrease the collar annually to prevent seizing (aluminum-in-steel especially). Carbon posts use carbon paste instead of grease.

stem.label: Stem
stem.notes: Lifetime component. Torque check bolts every 6 months (manufacturer spec varies, typically 5 Nm).

handlebar.label: Handlebar
handlebar.notes: Lifetime. Replace after any significant crash — hairline cracks in aluminum or carbon are hard to see. Inspect for corrosion under tape annually.

frame.label: Frame
frame.notes: Lifetime. Inspect for cracks twice a year, especially around welds, BB shell, and dropouts. Critical for carbon post-crash.

fork_rigid.label: Fork (rigid)
fork_rigid.notes: Lifetime. Inspect for cracks at the crown, steerer, and dropouts. Replace any carbon fork after a significant crash.

derailleur_hanger.label: Derailleur hanger
derailleur_hanger.notes: Inspect after every crash. Replace if bent — a bent hanger will destroy a rear derailleur.

fork_suspension_lower_service.label: Suspension fork lower leg service
fork_suspension_lower_service.notes: Oil and seal wiper service every 50 hours or 6 months (whichever first). Dirty conditions dramatically shorten interval.

fork_suspension_full_rebuild.label: Suspension fork full rebuild
fork_suspension_full_rebuild.notes: Damper oil and full seal kit every 200 hours or annually.

rear_shock_air_can_service.label: Rear shock air can service
rear_shock_air_can_service.notes: Every 50 hours or 6 months. Air can clean, regrease seals.

rear_shock_full_rebuild.label: Rear shock full rebuild
rear_shock_full_rebuild.notes: Every 200 hours or annually. Damper oil and seal kit.

dropper_post_service.label: Dropper post service
dropper_post_service.notes: Annual seal and oil service. Full rebuild every 2 years.

ebike_motor_service.label: Ebike motor service
ebike_motor_service.notes: Annual service per motor manufacturer (Bosch, Shimano STEPS, Yamaha, Brose). Check your motor manual — some require dealer-only service.

ebike_battery_health_check.label: Ebike battery health check
ebike_battery_health_check.notes: Annual capacity test via the motor system's app or display. Consider replacement when capacity drops below ~70% of original.
